conventions.eventNames: Title Case, '<Object> <Past-tense verb>' (e.g. 'Meal Logged'). Names are frozen once shipped: rename in the analytics tool, never in code.
conventions.propertyNames: snake_case. Enum values are lowercase snake_case.
conventions.identity: user_id = FitCircle profile UUID on every platform, set on sign-up/login/session restore, cleared on logout. Never email, name or username.
conventions.privacy: Never send health VALUES (calories, macros, weight, body fat, steps, water volume, workout minutes), free text, emails, names or photos. Send coarse bands or booleans instead (has_weight, duration_band).
conventions.providers: Clients send every event to all enabled providers (Amplitude, PostHog, Sentry breadcrumbs, debug console). A provider is enabled by its key in build config.
